scope: Summit identity and published approach association only; no full-track, coordinate, statistics or current-condition verification.

records.name: Angletarn Pikes (Angletarn Pikes North Top)
records.identityEvidence: Route visits the north top after the south top; this supports the catalogue north-top identity.

records.name: Baystones (Wansfell)
records.identityEvidence: Route continues beyond Wansfell Pike to the summit explicitly identified as Baystones.

records.name: Beda Fell (Beda Head)
records.identityEvidence: Route explicitly identifies Beda Head as the summit of Beda Fell.

records.name: Blencathra-Hallsfell Top
records.identityEvidence: Scales approach via Hall's Fell reaches Blencathra summit; Hallsfell Top identity corroborated by the publisher's Bowscale Fell overview.

records.name: Crag Hill (Eel Crag)
records.identityEvidence: Publisher explicitly explains Eel Crag as the fell named Crag Hill by Ordnance Survey.

records.name: Crinkle Crags-Long Top (Second Crinkle)
records.identityEvidence: Route explicitly reaches Long Top, after the first crinkle and the approach to the second.

records.name: Dodd (Skiddaw)
records.identityEvidence: Millbeck and Long Doors approach describes Dodd beside Skiddaw and Dodd Wood.

records.name: Fellbarrow-Mosser Fell
records.identityEvidence: Waterend/Mosser Fell Road approach reaches Fellbarrow; the Mosser Fell alternative name and NY132242 are corroborated separately.

records.name: Grange Fell (Brund Fell)
records.identityEvidence: Route via King's How continues to Brund Fell, rather than ending at the subsidiary top.

records.name: Great Crag (Stonethwaite)
records.identityEvidence: Stonethwaite/Lingy End approach reaches Great Crag above Dock Tarn.

records.name: Hartsop Above How (Gill Crag-Hartsop Above How)
records.identityEvidence: Bridgend ridge approach reaches Hartsop above How; Gill Crag identity and grid corroborated separately.

records.name: Heron Pike (Rydal)
records.identityEvidence: Grasmere/Alcock Tarn approach identifies the Heron Pike on the Rydal/Great Rigg ridge.

records.name: High Crag (Buttermere)
records.identityEvidence: Buttermere/Sheepbone Rake approach identifies the High Crag at the head of Buttermere.

records.name: High Rigg (Naddle Fell)
records.identityEvidence: Smaithwaite Bridge approach identifies High Rigg in St John's in the Vale; Naddle Fell alternative and grid corroborated separately.

records.name: Lingmoor Fell (Lingmoor Fell-Brown How)
records.identityEvidence: Elterwater route reaches Lingmoor Fell summit; Brown How identity corroborated separately.

records.name: Little Hart Crag (Little Hart Crag-West Top)
records.identityEvidence: Caiston Glen route reaches Little Hart Crag summit, then describes its lower eastern top separately.

records.name: Mellbreak (Mellbreak South Top)
records.identityEvidence: North-ridge route continues to the higher south top; the overview also identifies NY148186.

records.name: Rosthwaite Fell-Bessyboot
records.identityEvidence: Big Stanger Gill approach explicitly reaches Bessyboot, not Rosthwaite Cam.

records.name: Steel Fell (Dead Pike-Steel Fell)
records.identityEvidence: Mill Bridge/south-east ridge route explicitly identifies the actual top as Dead Pike.

records.name: Steel Knotts (Pikeawassa-Steel Knotts)
records.identityEvidence: Martindale Hause/Birkie Knott route explicitly identifies Pikeawassa as the summit of Steel Knotts.

records.name: Stony Cove Pike (Caudale Moor)
records.identityEvidence: Kirkstone Pass/St Raven's Edge route reaches Caudale Moor; Stony Cove Pike identity corroborated separately.

records.name: The Knott (High Street)
records.identityEvidence: Hartsop/Hayeswater approach identifies The Knott in the High Street group; keep it separate from Knott.

records.name: Whin Rigg (Wasdale)
records.identityEvidence: Irton Park/Irton Fell approach and Wastwater views identify the Wasdale fell.

records.name: Whinlatter (Brown How-Whinlatter)
records.identityEvidence: Route visits Whinlatter Top and continues along the ridge to Brown How.

records.name: Whiteside (Whiteside West Top)
records.identityEvidence: Lanthwaite Green/Whin Ben route visits the west top before discussing the higher east top separately.
